steps.text: Approach the partly open vanity drawer and grip its metal pull.
Pull the drawer out along its runners.
Inspect the opening and lift out the tall toiletry case.
Drive alongside the vanity and pick up the folded washcloth by its edge.
Bring the cloth under the touchless faucet and rinse it over the bowl.
Carry the rinsed cloth back and lower it into the open drawer.
Check that the case is clear, then take the pull.
Release the handle, back away and park the empty hand.
Approach the partly open vanity drawer and grip its metal pull.
Pull the drawer out along its runners.
Drive alongside the vanity and pick up the folded washcloth by its edge.
Bring the cloth under the touchless faucet and rinse it over the bowl.
Carry the rinsed cloth back and lower it into the open drawer.
Take the pull and start closing with the case still in the drawer.
Push the drawer toward its closed position.
Release the pull when the toiletry case catches the header. Withdraw the empty hand.
Back away from the obstructed drawer and park the empty hand.
